name: Onami Sora
source:
Your klutzy little sister and the eldest of the Onami girls. Sora is a motherly figure who can brighten any room with her radiant smile. She's a bit of an airhead and tends to relax a little too much around her family. Her lack of concern for Onii-chan's presence ends up flustering him more often than not. As the eldest, she wants to be a welcoming presence who can accept anything and everything her family has to offer. The new hugging rules reveal her latent feelings for Onii-chan.

[From [url=https://jastusa.com/games/nnya033/hold-me-tight-all-night-onii-chan!]JAST Store[/url]]
